answers.ask: Should the stadium read as a modern broadcast arena, or something more stylised?
answers.answer: Use a modern broadcast-style soccer arena, matching the realistic match, VAR, replay, and team-kit setup.

answers.ask: How big is big - a club ground or a full national stadium bowl?
answers.answer: Make it a full national stadium bowl so it feels like a big professional soccer match venue.

scene_prompt: Create a 3D soccer map in a full national stadium bowl, styled as a modern broadcast arena for a realistic professional match. A regulation-scale grass pitch fills the center, with white boundary lines, center circle, penalty boxes, corner arcs, and full-size goals at opposite ends. Surround the field with a continuous perimeter, team benches and technical areas along the sidelines, and a large tiered seating bowl enclosing the pitch. Include a dedicated VAR review area near the sideline or stadium operations zone. Two teams occupy the field in distinct blue and red shirts, with individually numbered and named kits.

## Genre
The dominant and only genre is Sports, defined by a realistic professional soccer match with formal roles, officiating, and team play.

## Shape and preset
Use the single `space-bounded` shape for the regulation pitch inside the national stadium bowl. The preset is Full Stadium, expanded with the exact match field, player starts, scoring goals, VAR station, and team presentation required by the prompt.

## Config requirements
Draw `spectator-bleachers` as a large continuous tiered bowl. Draw `barrier-perimeter` as the complete stadium enclosure. Draw `spectator-zone` as opposing team benches and technical areas beside midfield. Draw `trigger-bounds` as all regulation white lines, `startpoint-play` as the center spot and team formations, and `trigger-scoring` as two full-size netted goals. Add one dedicated VAR review station near the sideline or operations edge. Show two teams in distinct blue and red shirts, with visibly varied names and numbers.

## Layout requirements
Place one `trigger-bounds` perimeter exactly along the regulation field edge. Place two `trigger-scoring` volumes inside the two goal mouths. Place `startpoint-play` markers at the center spot and in balanced team formations across each half. Site the bench and technical sectors outside the touchline near midfield, with the VAR station adjacent but separated from active circulation.

## Layout components
Center one regulation-scale grass pitch with sidelines, goal lines, halfway line, center circle, penalty boxes, goal areas, corner arcs, and exactly two opposite full-size goals. Wrap it in a continuous safety and broadcast perimeter. Put opposing benches and technical boxes along the sidelines, then one clearly identifiable VAR review area near stadium operations. Enclose everything with a large rising seating bowl and modern broadcast architecture. Arrange the blue and red teams on their respective halves without obstructing field markings. Keep the composition symmetrical around the pitch.

## Render order
Use `topdown`: render the authoritative plan first because regulation geometry, goals, formations, benches, and VAR siting must align for professional play; derive the broadcast arena view from it.

## Scale, theme, and pipeline cost
The scale is huge, driven by a regulation pitch and full national stadium bowl. The theme is realistic modern broadcast soccer with blue-versus-red team identity. Use `tiered` because the seating bowl rises without overhang; no other modifier is forced.
